process TREERECS {
    tag "$meta.id"
    label 'process_low'

    conda "${moduleDir}/environment.yml"
    container "${ workflow.containerEngine == 'singularity' && !task.ext.singularity_pull_docker_container ?
        'https://depot.galaxyproject.org/singularity/treerecs:1.2--h9f5acd7_3':
        'quay.io/biocontainers/treerecs:1.2--h9f5acd7_3' }"

    input:
    tuple val(meta), path(genetree), path(speciestree)

    output:
    tuple val(meta), path("*.xml"), emit: rectree
    tuple val("${task.process}"), val('treerecs'), eval("treerecs --version | sed -n 's/^Treerecs \\([0-9.]*\\)\$/\\1/p'"), topic: versions, emit: versions_treerecs

    when:
    task.ext.when == null || task.ext.when

    script:
    def args = task.ext.args ?: ''
    def prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"
    """
    treerecs \\
        $args \\
        --genetree $genetree \\
        --speciestree $speciestree \\
        --outdir treerecs_tmp \\
        --output-format recphyloxml \\
        --force \\
        --parallelize

    mv treerecs_tmp/*.xml ${prefix}.recphylo.xml
    """

    stub:
    def args = task.ext.args ?: ''
    def prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"
    """
    echo $args

    touch ${prefix}.recphylo.xml
    """
}

---
name: "nf-core/treerecs"
description: "Treerecs is an open-source (species- and gene-) tree reconciliation\
  \ software distributed under the GNU AGPL licence. It can correct, rearrange and\
  \ (re-)root gene trees with regard to a given species tree. It was designed to be\
  \ both efficient and easy to install and to use."
keywords:
- "tree reconciliation"
- "species tree"
- "gene tree"
tools:
- treerecs:
    description: "correct, rearrange and (re-)root gene trees with regard to a given\
      \ species tree"
    homepage: "https://project.inria.fr/treerecs/"
    documentation: "https://project.inria.fr/treerecs/treerecs-options/"
    tool_dev_url: "https://gitlab.inria.fr/Phylophile/Treerecs"
    doi: "10.1093/bioinformatics/btaa615"
    licence:
    - "AGPL"
    identifier: "biotools:Treerecs"
input:
- - meta:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
        \ ]`\n"
  - genetree:
      type: "file"
      description: "Phylogenetic gene tree in text or xml format"
      pattern: "*.{tree, txt, nwk, newick, nhx, phyloxml, xml}"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_1910"
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3159"
  - speciestree:
      type: "file"
      description: "Phylogenetic species tree in text or xml format"
      pattern: "*.{tree, txt, nwk, newick, nhx, phyloxml, xml}"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_1910"
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3159"
output:
  rectree:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - '*.xml':
        type: "file"
        description: "Reconciled phylogenetic tree"
        pattern: "*.{tree, txt, nwk, newick, nhx, phyloxml, xml}"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_1910"
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3159"
  versions_treerecs:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - treerecs:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - treerecs --version | sed -n 's/^Treerecs \([0-9.]*\)\$/\1/p':
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
topics:
  versions:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - treerecs:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - treerecs --version | sed -n 's/^Treerecs \([0-9.]*\)\$/\1/p':
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
authors:
- "@leapicard"
maintainers:
- "@leapicard"
version: "0.0.0-6d1763b"
license: "MIT License"
